Sean Gallagher: seeing this too. :eyes: can someone confirm if this is real (not warmup / deploy window noise) before we start making changes?

Tomáš Novák: pulling up the dashboard now. quick check: is it only A100-80G slice or all GPUs?

Felix Schneider: in Grafana panel it’s *only* A100-80G. H100 slice looks flat. p95 up, and tokens/sec down ~9% (decode). 

Rafael Mendes: alert payload has runtime_build + scheduler_mode (nice). does it include runtime git SHA in the annotation panel? I only see the build string.

Omar El-Sayed: deploy annotation has git_sha=7f3c1d2 (from runtime deploy event). if you click the annotation you’ll see the full tag set.

Noah Patel: looking at per-slice drilldown: the step change lines up exactly with the RC deploy ~14 min ago. prefill latency steady, decode latency up. also batch stats changed a bit (avg batch size down), but scheduler_mode stable.

Sofia Ivanova: if batch size down, could be queue contention? but canary should be canary-safe + low priority. any chance the new RC changed priority handling?

Marcus Reed: canary runner is unchanged. still using request class `canary-safe` and pinning scheduler config (experimental heuristic X disabled). 

Hiro Tanaka: decode-only regression + A100-only makes me think kernel selection. can someone paste kernel id / fallback reason from the canary debug export?

Noah Patel: from the canary logs (last 5m):
```
selected_kernel_id=flash_attn_v3_a100
kernel_fallback_reason=none
kv_cache_mode=paged
max_seq_len_seen=2048
prefill_requests=1 decode_steps=128
```
was expecting flash_attn_v3_a100 anyway. but the kernel id isn’t changing vs baseline.

Omar El-Sayed: do we have the *scheduler queue metrics* panel? want to confirm no weird queue depth spikes.

Felix Schneider: queue depth is flat (canary queue near zero). runtime CPU seems a touch higher though (panel shows +6-8%).

Sean Gallagher: if this is correlated to RC deploy and not just batch variance, I’d rather rollback RC in us-east before we expand phase 1. anyone object?

Connor O'Brien: RC-1.18.0 is only in us-east canary pool right now (limited rollout). rollback is low blast radius. :+1:

Sofia Ivanova: +1 rollback. still want a follow-up to root cause but agree we shouldn’t leave the RC baking if it’s clearly worse.

Hiro Tanaka: +1 rollback. also can we capture a quick profile snapshot before we revert? even a short `nsys` on one canary pod could help.

Tomáš Novák: runbook says: confirm signal quality -> capture context -> mitigate. we have correlation + slices. if we can grab 1 trace quickly, do it, but don’t block rollback.

Rafael Mendes: I’ll kick rollback and note incident-bot thread. Connor can you confirm the exact previous known-good build tag?

Connor O'Brien: known-good in this pool was runtime-1.17.3+sha.1a9b0e4. rollback target is that.

Rafael Mendes: ok starting rollback. 
/deploy rollback inference-runtime us-east --pool=canary --to=runtime-1.17.3
